I have sent the video with the information and have not received anything yet

Yahoo Mail: Search, Organize, Conquer
Handed to the team · RMA approval is not mine to give; cannot open the return or buy a label until it

Hi James,

Thanks for sending the video through, and I'm sorry you're still waiting on a reply to it. It's landed on your case along with the serial, (number hidden), and Hal's verdict that the board is faulty.

What's holding things up is the approval on the return itself, which has to be signed off by JD or Georges before I can raise the label. That hasn't happened yet, and I won't pretend otherwise after you've asked this many times. I've put it back in front of them with everything attached.

The team is offline this evening and picks this up tomorrow at 10am ET. The approval and the return label come straight to this email address, so there's nothing you need to do or watch for in the meantime. Please keep the unit unplugged until the label arrives.

Sorry again for the run-around on this one, James.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

I don't have an order number and don't know who to ask from the silent auction I won it at. So without that information that means I have a miner that cannot be replaced and it a paper weight now?

VR James V.

Yahoo Mail: Search, Organize, Conquer
Handed to the team · No purchase record exists for the faulty unit, so warranty cover is a decision o

Hi James,

No, I'm not writing it off as a paperweight, and thank you for telling me where it came from. That's the piece we were missing.

Here's the honest position. Our warranty normally runs off the order the unit was sold on, and with an auction win there isn't one, so I can't tell you myself that it's covered. What I can do is put it in front of the people who can decide, and I've done that this morning with everything we have: the serial (number hidden), the fault Hal confirmed, and the fact that you came by it at a silent auction with no seller to go back to. The serial is a real identifier, so there is something for them to work from even without an order.

They're in at 10am ET today and this is on their list. The answer comes straight to this email address, so there's nothing you need to chase.

One thing in the meantime, if you can: anything at all that shows where the unit came from, a photo of the auction lot, a receipt, the name of the event or the organiser, helps their case for covering it. If you have none of that, send nothing, it isn't a condition.

Keep the unit unplugged and I'm sorry this has dragged on.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
